subject: one-shot spec (Claude Opus 5.0)
prompt: Make me a simulation game in pygame. It is a game of life with 3 types of entities: plants, herbivores and carnivores. A plant grows until eaten. Herbivores and carnivores start with high health; eating gains health, every turn loses health, at 0 HP they die. Carnivores gain HP by eating herbivores; herbivores gain HP by eating plants. Herbivores run away from carnivores; carnivores run toward herbivores to eat them.
